settings.title: Everything for dogs, cats and their people

settings.title: Nothing ships until Biscuit says yes

settings.editor: Every bed is slept on, every toy is chewed and every treat is taste-tested by the dogs and cats of our team. If it doesn't survive a week in the office, it doesn't make the shop.

settings.title: “Juno has destroyed every toy she's owned. The rope tug is on week six and still in one piece.”

settings.editor: Take 10% off your first order with the code WELCOME10. Your pet will never know.

settings.title: A pet shop run by pet people (and their pets)

settings.editor: We are a small team of dog walkers, cat sitters and one former vet nurse who got tired of gear that didn't last.

image.alt: The office dogs on their beds

settings.editor:
Biscuit, a ten-year-old beagle, tests beds. Juno, a terrier with a jaw like a vice, tests toys. Pixel the cat tests whatever she likes. Products that fail don't make the shop.

We choose durable materials, honest ingredients and makers who treat animals well, and we give 1% of every order to local shelters.

settings.description_text: Every product spends a week with our office pets.
Short ingredient lists you can actually read.
1% of every order goes to local shelters.

products.name: Orthopedic Dog Bed
products.description:
Ten centimetres of supportive memory foam under a removable, machine-washable cover with a raised bolster for chin-resting.

S fits dogs up to 10 kg, M up to 25 kg, L up to 45 kg. Non-slip base.
products.short_description: Memory foam for old joints and young nappers.

reviews.author: Sam Okafor
reviews.content: Biscuit-approved indeed. Our old lab sleeps through the night now.

reviews.author: Lena Fischer
reviews.content: Cover washes beautifully. Ordered the L and it's perfect for our shepherd.

products.name: Leather Leash
products.description:
Vegetable-tanned leather that softens with every walk, with solid brass hardware and a padded handle.

1.5 m long, 15 mm wide.

products.name: Reflective Harness
products.description:
A no-pull harness with a front clip, padded chest plate and reflective piping for dark evening walks.

Measure around the widest part of the chest: S 40–55 cm, M 55–70 cm, L 70–90 cm.

products.name: Ceramic Food Bowl
products.description:
A heavy stoneware bowl that doesn't slide or tip, glazed inside and out and dishwasher safe.

18 cm wide, holds 900 ml.

products.name: Cat Tree Tower
products.description:
Three levels of sisal posts, a hideaway cube and a plush hammock at the top for surveying the kingdom.

120 cm tall. Ships flat, assembles in ten minutes.

reviews.author: Nora Vance
reviews.content: Pixel's competitor, our cat Mochi, now lives at the top. Very sturdy.

products.name: Cardboard Scratcher
products.description:
A wave-shaped scratcher made from recycled corrugated card, with a pouch of organic catnip.

Reversible for twice the life.

products.name: Feather Wand
products.description: A bamboo wand with a bell and a bundle of naturally shed feathers. Swappable toy ends.

products.name: Cotton Rope Tug
products.description:
Thick braided cotton rope with two knots, for tug, fetch and a good chew. Cleans teeth as it goes.

45 cm long. Machine washable.

products.name: Squeaky Rubber Bone
products.description:
Natural rubber with a muffled squeaker, tough enough for strong chewers and soft enough for teeth.

Floats, so it's great for the beach.

products.name: Grooming Brush
products.description: A double-sided brush: pins for detangling and soft bristles for a shine. Beech wood handle.

products.name: Salmon Treats
products.description:
Bite-size treats made from just two ingredients: wild salmon and sweet potato. Gently baked, never fried.

150 g bag, about 90 treats.

reviews.author: Priya Shah
reviews.content: My fussy whippet loses her mind for these.

products.name: Puppy Starter Kit
products.description: A leather leash, a rope tug and a bag of salmon treats: everything a new puppy needs on day one.
